current_role: Chief legal officer of Airbnb (since 2024); informal adviser to Ro Khanna
summary: Ron Klain was chief of staff to Vice Presidents Al Gore (1995–1999) and Joe Biden (2009–2011), Obama's Ebola response coordinator (2014–2015), and Biden's first White House chief of staff (2021–2023). A longtime debate coach for Democratic nominees, he joined Airbnb as chief legal officer in 2024 and has been advising Ro Khanna on a possible 2028 run.
